584: def terminate(job, receipt_path, reason):
585:     c = control(job)
586:     need(c["phase"] in {"accepted", "running"}, "Only an active recorded worker can terminate")
587:     observed = observed_status(read(receipt_path), c["worker"])
588:     need(observed in {"failed", "interrupted"}, "Unknown/running/completed host is not proof of termination")
589:     need(isinstance(reason, str) and reason.strip(), "Termination needs reason and reconciliation next action")
590:     receipt = capture(job, receipt_path)
591:     ledger = ledger_image(job, c, observed, receipt)
592:     target = read(c["target"])
593:     if c["request"]["kind"] == "project":
594:         projectctl.finish(target, c["request"]["target_binding"]["task_id"], c["request"]["invocation_id"], "failed", reason=reason)
595:     c.update(phase="terminated", target_sha256=hashlib.sha256(body(target)).hexdigest())
596:     c["refs"].append(receipt)
597:     transaction(job, c["target"], [(job / "ledger.json", ledger), (Path(c["target"]), target), (job / "control.json", c)], c["refs"])
598:     return view(c)
